_README: Empirical title-format fixture for the end-detection window probe.
Each entry pins one (bundle_id, state) pair to the literal window
titles AX returned for the meeting app in that state, plus the
expected recognizer outcome.
`expected` takes exactly three values (HYG6):
recognize  asserted: the recognizer must return true for one title.
reject     asserted: it must return false for every title.
unknown    REPORTED, never asserted. A captured row nobody has
classified yet. The suite prints what the recognizer
actually returned for it; a human then rewrites the row
as recognize or reject. A `reject` on a real captured
title is a DET-band finding about isActiveMeetingWindow,
not a bad capture: file it, and never edit a captured
title to make the suite green.
Anything else fails the suite rather than reading as `reject`.
How to add real captures (Roadmap P1.1):
1. Open the app, drive it into the named state.
2. With Accessibility permission granted to a script, dump
`kAXWindowsAttribute -> kAXTitleAttribute` for that PID.
3. Drop the captured title list into a new entry below with
`expected: unknown`, re-run `WindowRecognizerFixtureTests`,
read the UNCLASSIFIED line it prints, and only then write
the verdict in.
`daemon/scripts/cal3-teams-title-probe.swift --report` emits entries
in exactly this shape (VALOWN1). Its `series` and `ad-hoc` kinds carry
the state names `in_meeting_named_series` and `in_meeting_ad_hoc`,
which have no seeded counterpart here and so are ADDED rather than
replacing a row; its `one-on-one` kind lands on `in_call_one_on_one`,
which does exist below and is replaced by the capture.
The current entries are seeded from `WindowRecognizerTests` and
represent expected formats, not yet field-verified captures.
Once Heorhii captures real titles, replace `seeded: true` with
`seeded: false` for that entry.
